positive.reasoning: Criterion A1 (traumatic event): MET — patient described a distressing incident where their safety was compromised. Criterion B1 (intrusive memories): MET — patient reported having intrusive thoughts and vivid recollections of the event. Criterion B2 (flashbacks): MET — patient mentioned experiencing a sense of reliving the moment when reminded of the event. Criterion B3 (distress at reminders): MET — patient noted increased anxiety and heart rate when reminded of the event. Criterion C1 (avoidance of thoughts): MET — patient stated they try to avoid reminders and thoughts related to the event. Criterion C2 (avoidance of reminders): MET — patient actively avoids places and conversations that trigger memories. Criterion D1 (negative beliefs about self/others): MET — patient reported a shift to negative thinking about themselves and the world. Criterion D2 (blame): MET — patient expressed a tendency to blame themselves for the event. Criterion D3 (negative emotional state): MET — patient described feelings of anxiety and fear as more pronounced. Criterion D4 (anhedonia): MET — patient reported a lack of interest in previously enjoyed activities. Criterion D5 (detachment): MET — patient described feeling detached from others. Criterion D6 (inability to experience positive emotions): MET — patient noted difficulty feeling enjoyment. Criterion D7 (irritability): MET — patient reported increased irritability and outbursts. Criterion D8 (recklessness): UNCLEAR — patient mentioned being more cautious but recognized some reckless behavior. Criterion D9 (hypervigilance): MET — patient reported increased vigilance and being on guard. Criterion D10 (startle response): MET — patient noted being more easily startled. Criterion D11 (concentration difficulties): MET — patient reported difficulty concentrating. Criterion D12 (sleep disturbances): MET — patient described ongoing difficulty sleeping. Criterion E (duration): MET — symptoms began after the traumatic event and have lasted for more than one month. Criterion F (functional impairment): MET — patient described significant distress and interference with daily functioning. Exclusion criteria: NOT MET — patient denied substance use or medical conditions contributing to symptoms. Total: 12 of 14 criteria met (threshold ≥ 5). Diagnosis: TRUE — full criteria for PTSD met with significant functional impairment confirmed.
